Etc. here are some of a few custom applications that integrates with all the refineries in order to continue their daily business requirements – Logbook application which deals with comments and tasks with regards to Area ,Unit, Assets, Assignees for a specified refinery in turn deals with’ mpro’ database in order to store the data for the specified refineries. Game Plan is the one which mainly concentrates on Refinery wide users’ requirements using the Microsoft office InfoPath forms and it will merge different InfoPath forms with data entered. Document Management System (DMS) which mainly gets the data from Documentum and displays the data based on query given by the user with content type and there are complex applications like Operating envelopes (deals with refinery wide Operating Points, Summary Reports of the Refineries, Trend Charts of Refineries etc.) Analyzer Performance (AP- deals with Control Grid, Status of the Control points etc.) Advisory Reports (deals mainly with Reports based on Refinery wide filter values).
